description: This file defines a generic class BestFitBalancer that manages resource distribution among buckets, ensuring even and deterministic allocation, with methods for initializing ideal distributions and recalculating distributions based on active buckets.

classes.name: BestFitBalancer`2
classes.description: A generic class implementing a resource balancing algorithm that maintains an ideal distribution of resources across buckets and recalculates distributions based on active buckets, ensuring even and deterministic resource allocation.

methods.name: BestFitBalancer`2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the balancer with a set of buckets and resources, computing the ideal distribution.

methods.name: GetDistribution
methods.description: Calculates and returns a resource distribution for a given set of active buckets, redistributing resources from inactive buckets evenly among active ones.

methods.name: BuildIdealDistribution
methods.description: A private static method that creates an initial, evenly distributed, deterministic allocation of resources among buckets.
